title: 我想自己玩一会儿
subtitle: 说「不」也可以，好好说
character: wearing a green t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream

pages.zh:
有时候我不想说话，
只想自己
摆一排恐龙。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting alone on the floor lining up small toy dinosaurs in a row, absorbed, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
表弟又跑过来了。
「一起玩！」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting with his row of toy dinosaurs while a younger boy runs up beside him, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
我不想。
可是我怕他不高兴。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting with his hand over one toy dinosaur, glancing sideways at the younger boy, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
妈妈说：
「不想玩可以说，
说清楚就行。」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting on the floor with his mother, who sits beside him and talks to him, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
我想了想，说：
「我想自己玩一会儿。」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, looking at the younger boy and speaking, one hand on his own chest, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
再加一句时间：
「摆完这一排就找你。」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, pointing at his row of toy dinosaurs while the younger boy listens beside him, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
表弟去玩别的了。
我把最后一只
摆好了。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, placing the last toy dinosaur at the end of his long row on the floor, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
我说到做到。
我拿着两只恐龙
去找他。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, walking across the room holding two toy dinosaurs, looking towards the younger boy, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
「换我们一起玩了。」
他一下子跳起来。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, handing one toy dinosaur to the younger boy, who jumps up happily, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
要是他先说不呢？
那我也等一等，
不缠着他。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting quietly on the floor with one toy dinosaur while the younger boy plays apart, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
想自己玩不是不友好。
说清楚，
再说到做到。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting on the floor with the younger boy, both moving toy dinosaurs, calm and friendly, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.

pages.zh:
停一停，
说出来，
再给一个办法。
三步，我记住了。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing holding one toy dinosaur, looking at the viewer, confident and calm, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural. Art style: children's picture book illustration, light ink wash painting with soft brush edges, muted green, warm grey and cream.
